snippet.title: Huntervania – Official Launch Trailer | Available Now on Steam
snippet.description:
Hunt. Grow stronger. Survive the night.

Huntervania is a dark fantasy pixel-art survivor roguelite where you face endless hordes of monsters, deadly assassins and powerful bosses.

Choose your hunter, master a deadly arsenal of weapons, discover powerful upgrades and create devastating builds. Complete corrupted shrines, hunt Treasure Goblins and fight for the highest place on the global leaderboards.

Every run grows more dangerous. How long can you survive?

⚔️ Available now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4608410/Huntervania/

Join the hunt and add Huntervania to your Steam library!

Huntervania is a solo-developed indie game inspired by gothic horror, classic action games and modern survivor roguelites.

#Huntervania #IndieGame #SurvivorRoguelite
